record.oneLiner: The archetypal long-necked sauropod of the Morrison Formation.
record.description: Brontosaurus was a large diplodocid sauropod of the Late Jurassic Morrison Formation, the archetypal 'long-necked dinosaur' in popular culture. Long treated as a synonym of Apatosaurus, a 2015 study restored it as a distinct genus.

notableFacts.text: The archetypal 'long-necked' dinosaur of popular culture.
Long sunk into Apatosaurus, it was restored as a separate genus in 2015.
